scenes.title: The Uninvited Engine
scenes.setting_description: Approach road to garage, unmarked black SUV with headlights off in mist, cold moonlight

dialogues.speaker: Arjun
dialogues.text: అన్నా... ఈ టైమ్‌లో కస్టమర్లా? లేక దారి తప్పిన వాళ్లా?

scenes.title: Silent Preparation
scenes.setting_description: Inside workshop workbench, swinging single incandescent bulb, dark tool racks
scenes.character_action_prompt: cinematic close-up of Aditya Varma, intense cold eyes, slipping heavy steel wrench into black sleeve, completely calm and dangerous, tactical posture, volumetric dust in light beam, 8k

dialogues.speaker: Aditya
dialogues.text: అర్జున్... లోపలికి వెళ్లి వెనుక తలుపు బోల్ట్ వెయ్యి.

scenes.title: Breach on the Perimeter
scenes.setting_description: Side alley of workshop, two masked tactical mercenaries climbing wall with suppressed pistols
scenes.character_action_prompt: cinematic shot of tactical black mercenaries sneaking near metal corrugated wall, dark blue moonlight, suppressed handguns, high tension cinematic thriller atmosphere, 8k

dialogues.speaker: Narrator
dialogues.text: పదిహేడేళ్లుగా దాక్కున్న ఆ నిజం... ఈ రాత్రి వెలుగు చూడబోతోంది.
